title: [Dev] Notification "Fallback to SMB. Not enough TDD data." showing when DynISF is OFF
body:
AAPS 3.3.0-dev-e
Build: ffb17e9b15-2024.12.09
Engineering mode enabled 


I dont have 7 days of TDD data on my test-rig. Dynamic sensitivity = off. This notification triggers every loop run. I can't fall back to SMB when I am using SMB :)
